proof_scope: Real project CLI: file/folder anonymization, review-only RapidFuzz discovery and explicit exact-policy approval on synthetic inputs.

claims.proves: Four-format approved-alias workflow, unchanged originals, private artifacts, safe paths, deterministic proposals, ambiguity/type/protected boundaries, stale/forged review refusal and resource caps.
claims.does_not_prove: General PII discovery, correct human identity adjudication, hostile-host isolation, production scale or the previously qualified archive covering this new feature.

cases.name: four-formats-and-relative-file-interface
command: cd .. && uv run --extra dev --extra discovery python -m pytest -q tests/test_discovery.py tests/test_discovery_boundaries.py -k 'all_four_formats or single_file_relative_paths'

cases.name: approval-authority-and-tampering
command: cd .. && uv run --extra dev --extra discovery python -m pytest -q tests/test_discovery.py tests/test_discovery_boundaries.py -k 'forged or stale_or_edited or approval_requires or approval_rechecks'

cases.name: identity-ambiguity-and-discovery-scope
command: cd .. && uv run --extra dev --extra discovery python -m pytest -q tests/test_discovery.py tests/test_discovery_boundaries.py -k 'noise or near_ties or aliases_of_one or policy_without or deterministic_and'

cases.name: input-resource-and-filesystem-boundaries
command: cd .. && uv run --extra dev --extra discovery python -m pytest -q tests/test_discovery.py tests/test_discovery_boundaries.py -k 'invalid or malformed or budget or special_file or work_artifacts'
